body.title: Thin rotation-aware LogTail (new log-tail.ts)
body.summary: Create vscode-plugin/src/panels/log-tail.ts: createLogTail(deps: LogTailDeps { logDir, stem, listSegments, readLines, watch, maxLines }): LogTail with follow(onLines): () => void — emits the maxLines-bounded initial tail of the active segment, then follows appends + rotation (active-segment tracking) on a watch event; idempotent dispose flips a disposed flag (no post-dispose emit + removes the watcher); NEVER throws (every listSegments/readLines/watch call try/caught). Mirrors the CLI src/cli/services/debug.ts tailLogWith WITHOUT importing it (k5). VS-Code-free; reads only local files.
acceptanceChecks: follow emits the bounded initial tail then follows appended lines on a watch event; a rotation (active segment change) is tracked without drop/duplicate
dispose() is idempotent and guarantees no onLines fires after dispose
a missing dir / readLines throw / watch throw is swallowed (never throws); imports no 'vscode', no cloud, and NOT src/cli/services/debug.ts

tests.name: log-tail: follow emits the maxLines-bounded initial tail then follows appended lines on a watch event
log-tail: a rotation (active segment roll) is tracked — appends emit from the new segment without drop/duplicate
log-tail: dispose() is idempotent and guarantees no onLines fires after dispose
log-tail: a missing dir / readLines throw / watch throw is swallowed — follow never throws
